config.notes: Athabasca University (athabascau.ca), online/distance only, text only, no page JSON. IRCC does not issue study permits for AU online programmes (https://www.athabascau.ca/applications-admissions/apply-au/international-students.html): international students can study from outside Canada only. Page kinds: /programs/summary/<programme>.html (all 35 read pages). Undergraduate pages: "Next start: monthly", "no set start dates - you can enrol at any time" (no months to read); fees are per course (tables for Alberta, out-of-province and students living outside Canada) - no annual figure, so no fee pattern. Graduate pages: "Application deadlines and start dates" table "deadline | start" (e.g. "June 15, 2026 Aug. 2026"): intakes = the start month after each dated deadline (pick all); term_months maps the printed abbreviation "Sept" to September (course pages print "Sept."); MSc Information Systems lists terms "Fall"/"Winter" with no published month mapping, so it gives no months; EdD: "classes start in May". Graduate fees are per course or whole-programme estimated totals (MBA ESTIMATED TOTAL) - not read. Duration = "Finish this program in as little as ..."; study_level = "Credential: ...". No page carries IELTS: central rule IELTS 6.0 overall (undergraduate https://www.athabascau.ca/calendar/undergraduate/admission-registration-evaluation/english-language-proficency.html; graduate https://www.athabascau.ca/calendar/graduate/additional-information/english-language-proficiency-requirements.html).
